experiment_data.notes: CIVO collapse confirmed: eval 40.8@105K (from peak ~488@75K). NVE peaked 1.66× at 95K (35K+ window). Full-SGS did NOT prevent collapse in seed 2 — contradicts 018v2 (seed 1) which avoided collapse. This invalidates SGS_full as a reliable CIVO prevention method. Key difference from 018v2: 018_s2 collapsed while 018v2 sustained. n=2 for SGS_full now shows collapse_rate=0.5.
